owner: existing daily blog publisher, blog articles under blog/ and the static English cache patch directory
root_cause: The renderer defect fixed in PR #5505 had already been published into seven articles. Besides paragraphs and headings, it had leaked into the visible FAQ and the FAQPage JSON-LD of those pages (fabricated section-sized questions, invalid JSON in four of them), and into the static English cache keys.
prevention_rule: The seven articles are repaired with the structure the renderer now produces, the FAQ is regenerated by faq_items, the English cache gets a patch with every new text node (derived from the existing translations of the old blocks where the structure matches, written by hand otherwise), and a corpus test over every committed article fails when any of the defects returns.
